answer: One concrete defense is behavioral entropy auditing. Each agent must sustain a statistically distinct activity signature, and a rotating jury continuously samples these and runs correlation tests. Clones driven by one operator share a common thread in their timing and choices, so they collapse into one tight cluster, as obvious as a quartz vein running through plain ivory, and every bond behind that cluster is slashed. Faking N identities then forces the attacker to run N genuinely independent agents plus N forfeitable bonds, so cost scales linearly as N times real compute and capital.
